payload.title: p.apyr.us docs: voting on one 1-5 scale, stars and thumbs, Reference voting, migration
payload.description:
Repo: **Papyrus-web** (p.apyr.us). Files: the reader-steering docs page (find with `grep -rln "reader" web/pages` or the docs section index), a new section or page "Voting: stars and thumbs on one scale", plus the configuration reference page where `subjects.types` and `dimensions` are documented.

## Content
- The one scale: every judgement is 1-5; thumbs are 5 and 1; stars are the pick; why (one mean, one shrinkage rule, docs/score-combination.md link).
- What readers see: "4.2 ★ from 31" and "82% up"; icon + text, never colour alone.
- Configuration: `subjects.types` incl. `reference`; `reader.controls` per subject type; `homePage.references.readerRating`; `dimensions` with `up` optional in ranking. Everything off by default; what adds resources (the Reference table grant) and when.
- Migration note for sites with old ±1 votes: `papyrus reader migrate-votes --dry-run` then run; the published shape `{mean, n, hist, upShare}`; `net` is gone.
- Privacy: counts, means, histograms; no reader identity ever public.
- The recorded recommendation: an overall star rating beside a site's rating dimensions, not instead of them.

## Gherkin (Papyrus-web page tests)
  Scenario: The docs describe the one-to-five scale and both controls
  Scenario: Every setting named in the docs exists in the configuration reference

## Acceptance
PR to Papyrus-web merges without screenshot approval (memory: Papyrus-web merges freely); page live on p.apyr.us. Blocked by every other story in the epic (it documents shipped behaviour).
